capabilities.scope: Vendor boot0, U-Boot and the board-specific DT path boot from microSD.
This board has no Ethernet port. A related A733 board does not establish an Ethernet path here.
AIC8800D80 needs vendor firmware. Nonzero initial IGTK IPN is unsupported in the cited snapshot.

Native Vulkan Compute has bounded hardware acceptance. HWRT, firmware event dispatch and paired graphics submissions have host contracts. Graphics execution, Zink, PRIME, display and accelerated Plasma remain unaccepted.
No model-execution receipt is included in this starter profile. Read current OS work before selecting this for inference.
